notes: Three-stage meter evolution in 14 months: flat plans → premium request units (2025) → token-based AI Credits (June 2026). Grandfathering with silently increased model multipliers is a notable partial-degradation pattern.

change_events.description: Premium-request billing enforcement began (system announced April 2025 with Pro+): allowances per plan (reported: Pro 300/mo, Pro+ 1,500, Business 300/user, Enterprise 1,000/user), overage $0.04/request, per-model multipliers.
Unannounced-in-advance tightening of Individual plan limits and pause on self-serve Business signups.

Premium request units replaced by GitHub AI Credits consumed by token usage (input+output+cached) at published per-model API rates; completions/Next Edit exempt; model fallback removed. Announced April 27, 2026. Annual Pro/Pro+ subscribers keep premium-request pricing until expiry BUT with increased model multipliers from June 1 — partial silent degradation of grandfathered terms.
change_events.grandfathering: partial — legacy pricing retained for annual subs with worsened multipliers
change_events.user_reaction: Documented backlash: 'you will get less, but pay the same price'
